newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline easier, U.S. arbitrage unworkable.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline easier, U.S. arbitrage unworkable.

text.p: NWE gasoline was softer on Friday as the market absorbed Thursday's tumble on NYMEX futures.
Benchmark eurograde barges traded some $4 lower down at $215.50 and $216 a tonne fob ARA, while regular held steady on the last deal done to trade at $203.50 and $204.
Cargoes were also weaker despite limited buying interest from the U.K. and Germany, as well as some demand for superplus into France.
The transatlantic arbitrage was not seen workable.
Premium unleaded cargoes were pegged at $218/$220 cif NWE.
